messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT created — serving-runtime pod prod-runtime-34 reported repeated `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` / misaligned memory accesses. Error frequency rising, automated rollback not triggered
Alex Kim: Paging oncall. I'm on notifications.
Li Chen: I'm oncall, pinging eng-runtime. seeing OOMs + illegal address. Any immediate mitigation?
Jordan Patel: Notified eng-runtime and eng-ml. We saw similar pattern last month but not this wide.
Tasha Gómez: Quick check — is this only for model-rn/2 or all models on that node?
Alex Kim: Logs show kernel failure in attention kernel; sample:
```
E tensorflow: cuda_runtime.cc:456 cudaErrorIllegalAddress: misaligned address at 0x7ff... kernel: fwd_attention.cu:123
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
```
Li Chen: Nodes: prod-gpu-n12 (gpu0 stuck), prod-runtime-34 is on that node. Rate spiked at 11:06 UTC.
Jordan Patel: Customer impact: two customers (acme-inc, zephyr-ai) report elevated 500s for generation requests > 1024 tokens.
Tasha Gómez: Mitigation plan: 1) stop scheduling new jobs on the node (cordon/drain), 2) fallback to model-variant fp16-compat on other nodes, 3) restart runtime pod after core dump collection, 4) engage eng-runtime for hotpatch.
Alex Kim: I'll cordon node now: `kubectl cordon prod-gpu-n12` and drain non-critical pods. Will keep stateful serving pods as evict=false unless fallback.
Li Chen: Evict critical serving pods with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` carefully. Starting live traffic reroute to dedicated nodes via traffic policy set.
oncall-bot: Handoff reminder: Tasha taking 30m shift at 11:30 UTC
Tasha Gómez: Draining now; starting `kubectl drain prod-gpu-n12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m` — some pods failed to evict due to stuck docker runtime.
Jordan Patel: Attempting container restart: `crictl ps` shows runtime stuck; `crictl stop` returned error `failed to stop container: rpc error: code = Internal desc = failed to shim container`.
Alex Kim: Collected core and dmesg; attaching short snippet:
```
[dmesg] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, pid=12345, pid_name=runtime_server
kernel: BUG: alignment fault/unaligned access at 0x7ff... in fwd_attention_kernel
```
Li Chen: Eng-runtime suggests disabling fused attention kernel as hot-fix and switching to reference kernel in runtime config:
```
runtime.config.enable_fused_attention=false
runtime.config.attention_impl=reference
```
Tasha Gómez: Applying config to canary subset (replica set rs-runtime-canary) then rolling to healthy nodes.
deploy-bot: Started rollout of config change to rs-runtime-canary (3/3)
Jordan Patel: Canary logs show no illegal address errors after config flip for ~2m, throughput down ~10% but stable.
Alex Kim: Promote config to cluster with gradual rollout and automatic rollback if error rate > 1% of baseline.
oncall-bot: Incident severity updated to P1 due to multi-tenant customer impact.
Li Chen: Notifying support/customer-success to message customers. @customer-success please send status.
customer-success: Messaged affected customers with initial details and ETA for mitigation. Will update with timeline and postmortem promise.
Tasha Gómez: Node remediation: full reboot scheduled after draining to recover GPU driver state. Will preserve logs to /mnt/diagnostics/prod-gpu-n12/
Alex Kim: Live workaround applied, traffic shifted; monitoring shows 95th latency back to normal for most routes. Affected customers still have intermittent failures for long requests — plan to throttle token limits per-request to 1024 until full stability.
Li Chen: Assigning follow-up: eng-runtime to triage root cause (kernel vs driver), eng-ml to retest model kernels with address sanitizer / smaller batch sizes. Postmortem owner: Alex Kim.
Jordan Patel: Any need to escalate to NVIDIA support / kernel team? Error looks like misaligned pointer inside fused kernel; we should attach wkld reproducer and core dump.
Alex Kim: Yes, opening support case with driver + core dump + reproducer script. Also creating a minimal repro harness to run in CI.
oncall-bot: Handoff: Li handing to Tasha at 12:15 UTC. Next oncall actions: confirm node reboot success and verify no re-occurence for 30m.
Tasha Gómez: Confirmed reboot completed at 12:02 UTC, gpu driver v535.54 loaded. No further illegal address logs for 25m.
Jordan Patel: Marking incident as mitigated for live traffic. Will keep P1 until reproducibility is fully resolved.
Alex Kim: Notes for post-incident: (1) add a runtime probe to detect `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` and auto-fallback, (2) expand canary to include long-run token requests, (3) add kernel-mode telemetry to capture warp-level offsets in logs.
customer-success: Customers updated; requesting postmortem and timeline for RCA.
Alex Kim: Thanks team. Creating postmortem ticket and assigning to eng-runtime/eng-ml. Will attach logs and reproducer.
